page.notes: Doubtful readings: "complura" (printed as "compluria," [?] not marked as the letter is faint); the line-initial letters of "fuisse," and "constat," are hard to read at the edge; "eorum" is partly obscured. Marginal note "6." sits beside the first paragraph. The horizontal rule across the middle is a printed ornament and is not transcribed. The faint text and large initial below the top line are show-through from the other side of the leaf and are not transcribed. The left strip is cut at its inner edge, so the line beginnings are missing. The top line is set in a heavier face than the strip, and its words are italic in parts as shown. The "PRÆ" mark may be a gathering signature or a catchword; it is placed as a signature here.
